title: Lifelong Context Adaptation through Bidirectional Memory-Skill Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.32295v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Lifelong LLM agents must learn from an expanding history of interactions while making each decision within a bounded context window. Memory makes past experience available, but the agent may still need to infer how to solve each new task from the retrieved records. Skills provide reusable procedures, yet may omit the task-specific facts needed to apply them. Because retrieved memory and skills shape the agent's behavior, they also influence the experience available for future learning. We introduce MemCryst, a framework for lifelong context adaptation through bidirectional learning of memory and skills with a frozen language model. Recurring episodes stored in memory support skill creation and revision, and the interactions guided by those skills supply new memory for subsequent learning. translated_title: 通过双向记忆-技能学习实现终身上下文适应
translated_abstract: 终身学习的大语言模型智能体必须从不断扩展的交互历史中学习，同时需要在有限的上下文窗口内做出每个决策。记忆使过去的经验可用，但智能体仍可能需要从检索到的记录中推断如何解决每个新任务。技能提供了可复用的操作程序，却可能遗漏应用它们所需的任务特定事实。由于检索到的记忆和技能塑造了智能体的行为，它们也会影响未来学习可用的经验。我们提出了MemCryst，一个通过冻结语言模型进行记忆与技能双向学习来实现终身上下文适应的框架。存储在记忆中的重复情节支持技能的创建和修订，而这些技能所引导的交互又为后续学习提供新的记忆。从记忆中检索的事实和已学习的技能共同构成智能体的上下文，同时任务结果会调整记录在未来检索中的影响力。
tldr: 提出MemCryst框架，通过记忆与技能的双向学习，让冻结的大语言模型智能体在有限上下文窗口内实现终身上下文适应——记忆中的重复情节支持技能创建与修订，技能引导的交互又产生新记忆，形成持续学习的闭环。
en_tdlr: MemCryst enables lifelong context adaptation for LLM agents through bidirectional memory-skill learning with a frozen language model, where recurring episodes in memory support skill creation and revision, while skill-guided interactions supply new memory for continuous learning.
